_comment: 'Character.limb_state is a LimbId -> intact | disabled | severed map,
written via patch_record on threshold crossings, REPLACE_PER_SUBFIELD per
limb.' Two systems read this field, independently, from the same source of
truth: Lobster, before resolving a hit-test, so a severed limb offers no
hitbox; and Shrimp's animation controller, to decide what to do about it.
Neither reads it on the other's behalf.
It ships as a separate package because SchemaRegistry.apply_extension
rejects the same field declared by two different packages. If Octopus or
Shrimp ends up owning this declaration, drop this file and keep the rest
of Lobster unchanged - lobster.octopus_bridge reads the field if it is
there and treats its absence as 'all limbs intact' (DECISIONS.md D2).
Who WRITES it is not Lobster. Scope 5 gives per-limb damage state to
Octopus core + the stats module; Lobster only ever reads.

Character.name: limb_state
Character._doc: LimbId -> 'intact' | 'disabled' | 'severed'. REPLACE_PER_SUBFIELD so each limb resolves independently and the highest layer wins per limb.
